physionet.negative_definition: T0 intervals inside repetitive imagery runs
caveats: The cue is synchronized but attempted movement onset is not measured.
No EOG, EMG, force, or motion validation is available.

openbmi.intent_definition: left/right hand imagery after a visual instruction
openbmi.negative_definition: fixed post-imagery interval from the same trial
caveats: Post-task rest is temporally predictable and not unrestricted idle.
EMG channels are retained for validation but excluded from EEG decoding.

liu2024.intent_definition: left/right hand-grip imagery during protocol stage 2
caveats: Rest is a structured trial stage rather than natural clinical idle.
Healthy/stroke comparisons are confounded by acquisition and protocol.
No simultaneous EMG, force, or motion ground truth is distributed.

hard_negative.negative_definition: continuous no-control EEG containing ordinary idle and documented artifacts
caveats: Recordings must be held out by subject/session.
Artifact labels must not be treated as intent labels.

evaluation.primary_endpoint: event sensitivity at a fixed continuous false-activation budget
evaluation.secondary_endpoint: left/right accuracy conditional on accepted motor intent
evaluation.operating_point: <=1 false activation/minute, >=60% sensitivity, <=2.5 s median latency
evaluation.confirmation_rule: A claim-bearing result requires a never-inspected subject/session or external dataset after every preprocessing, feature, model, fusion, and threshold choice.

prospective_acquisition.safety_note: Configuration only. No clinical command or autonomous device output is enabled.
